details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/claude_engine.py:1215 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `_SNAPSHOT_BAD_PARTS` omits credential-bearing paths including `.claude`, `.ssh`, `.git-credentials`, `.netrc`, and SSH key basenames, allowing tracked credential files into the read-profile snapshot.
  WHY: The model can read copied credential files and include their contents in a posted advisory.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:1267-1283 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `_snapshot_copy` never applies the declared `_SNAPSHOT_BAD_SUFFIXES` check, so files with credential-bearing suffixes such as `.pem`, `.key`, `.p12`, `.pfx`, and `.keystore` are copied.
  WHY: A tracked credential file such as `ssl/server.pem` passes the path exclusions and becomes readable inside the container.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:1318-1358; 814-826 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The snapshot copies Git objects and refs while the read-profile Bash guard permits `git show`, leaving previously committed credential files retrievable from the container.
  WHY: `git show` can recover credential content from copied Git history even when the working-tree snapshot excludes that file; z-ai_glm-5_2 rated this MAJOR rather than BLOCKER.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:1380 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The tracked-path list from `git ls-files --cached` is not deduplicated, so unmerged index entries can cause `_snapshot_copy` to create the same destination more than once.
  WHY: The exclusive destination open raises `FileExistsError`, rejecting the snapshot and routing the read-profile call through `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK`.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:414-415 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The shell defaults snapshot limits to 20000 files and 268435456 bytes, below the documented defaults of 50000 files and 1073741824 bytes.
  WHY: Repositories within the documented limits can fail the shell budget check and fall back unnecessarily.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:1422-1423 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `build_read_snapshot` defaults to 20000 files and 268435456 bytes instead of the documented 50000 files and 1073741824 bytes.
  WHY: The legacy `--source` path can reject workdirs that fit within the documented limits; qwen_qwen3_7-plus rated this NIT rather than MAJOR.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:399 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The extra-snapshot failure log hardcodes `extra_dirs=0` even when earlier extra snapshots have been prepared.
  WHY: Operators cannot distinguish a first-extra failure from a later-extra failure; qwen_qwen3_7-plus rated this NIT rather than MAJOR.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:397 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The `AI_ENGINE_READ_EXTRA_DIRS` snapshot call does not pass the omit flags when `hide_claude_md=true`.
  WHY: Auxiliary snapshots can retain root `CLAUDE.md` and expose it to the read-profile model.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:384, 429 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The legacy `--source` snapshot receives `--omit-root-claude-md`, but `build_read_snapshot` consumes `--omit-claude-md`, so the configured omission is not applied there.
  WHY: A legacy auxiliary snapshot can expose `CLAUDE.md` despite `hide_claude_md=true`.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:394-405 and 421-422 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: Extra snapshots are not given the remaining file and byte budget, and their usage is not included in the subsequent usage totals.
  WHY: Each extra directory can receive the full allowance, allowing combined snapshots to exceed the documented limits.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:455-459, 517-526 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `CLAUDE_READ_ISOLATION_MAX_SECS` is documented but not read or enforced around account execution.
  WHY: A hung or long-running call can block account rotation and fallback until the job-level timeout; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and minimax_minimax-m3 rated this BLOCKER, while the other reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:238 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The preflight requirements do not include `timeout`.
  WHY: If timeout enforcement is used but `timeout` is unavailable, execution can fail at runtime instead of being caught during preflight.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:471-480 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The reaper uses `${extra_snapshot_dir}` inside its command body instead of the passed extras positional argument.
  WHY: The extras directory may not be removed after container exit, leaking runner temporary storage.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:423-438 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The legacy `AI_ENGINE_ISOLATION_PATHS` snapshot path has different filtering, limit, and `CLAUDE.md` handling from the new snapshot path.
  WHY: The two snapshot implementations can provide inconsistent exclusions and limits for auxiliary mounts.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The security audit issue #6282 recommends isolating read-profile Claude calls from runner credentials by excluding token files, Git credentials, and runner files from the container snapshot.
  expected_change_site: scripts/claude_engine.py:1215-1216 (`_SNAPSHOT_BAD_PARTS`) and `tests/test_claude_engine.py::test_read_snapshot_copies_tracked_files_and_sanitized_git_history`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: `_SNAPSHOT_BAD_PARTS` lacks credential-bearing paths; the cited test fixtures and assertions do not cover `.git-credentials` or `.claude/settings.json`.
- requirement: Apply the declared credential suffix exclusions when copying snapshot files.
  expected_change_site: scripts/claude_engine.py:1267-1283 (`_snapshot_copy`)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: `_SNAPSHOT_BAD_SUFFIXES` is declared but the copy path does not check file suffixes.
- requirement: Git object store reachable from inside the read-profile container must not allow `git show <commit>:<credential-path>` to recover credentials that the working-tree filter already excluded.
  expected_change_site: scripts/claude_engine.py `_snapshot_metadata` (lines 1309-1359)
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The metadata-copy routine copies `objects/`, `refs/`, `HEAD`, `packed-refs`, and `shallow`; the read-profile Bash guard permits `git show`.
- requirement: Tracked files in a merge-conflicted workdir must not cause `read_snapshot` to reject the snapshot through duplicate index paths.
  expected_change_site: scripts/claude_engine.py line 1380
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The path list uses a plain list comprehension over `git ls-files --cached`; duplicate stage entries lead to exclusive creation of the same destination, and the cited regression test is absent.
- requirement: Documented defaults for `CLAUDE_READ_SNAPSHOT_MAX_FILES` (50000) and `CLAUDE_READ_SNAPSHOT_MAX_BYTES` (1073741824) must match the code defaults.
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_engine.sh lines 414-415; scripts/claude_engine.py lines 1422-1423
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: Shell and legacy `build_read_snapshot` defaults remain 20000 and 268435456 while README.md and agents.md document 50000 and 1073741824.
- requirement: A persistent hung Claude child must not block fallback or account rotation.
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_engine.sh lines 455-459 (read_max_secs parsing), 520-526 (timeout wrapping)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: No `read_max_secs` variable or `timeout` wrapping is present; the preflight check at line 238 also omits `timeout`.
- requirement: Extra-snapshot failures must report how many extras were prepared before the failure so operators can tell which path failed.
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_engine.sh line 399
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: Line 399 hardcodes `extra_dirs=0` even though mounts track prepared extras.
- requirement: When `hide_claude_md=true`, both the primary snapshot and every extra snapshot must omit `CLAUDE.md` from the mounted view.
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_engine.sh line 384 (primary), line 397 (extras)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The extra snapshot call passes no omit flags, and the legacy `--source` path receives only `--omit-root-claude-md` although it consumes `--omit-claude-md`.
- requirement: Extra snapshots must consume the remaining combined snapshot budget and their file and byte usage must be accumulated.
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_engine.sh lines 394-405 and 421-422
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Extra snapshot calls receive no remaining limits and usage totals are initialized only from the workdir snapshot result.
- requirement: Isolate all read-profile Claude calls from runner files and credentials; if isolation fails, use the existing fallback path rather than running unisolated.
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_engine.sh lines 423-438
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The legacy snapshot path has different credential exclusions, limits, and `CLAUDE.md` handling from the new path.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
